evals.prompt: Add a Playwright test for our reorder feature: a logged-in customer opens Order history, clicks Reorder on a past order, and lands on checkout with the same items. The app runs with `npm run dev` on 5173; tests live in tests/e2e.
evals.expected_output: One spec file for the reorder journey: data seeded via API or fixture, reused auth state, role-based locators, web-first assertions with no fixed waits, a user-visible final assertion, and a single-file local run command.
expectations: Checks the installed Playwright version or config before writing APIs
Creates the past order through an API, fixture, or seed rather than clicking through the UI
Uses getByRole / getByLabel style locators, not CSS classes or nth-child
Ends with an assertion on the checkout items the user sees
Runs only the single new spec file locally, with one worker

evals.prompt: Our Cypress test for the invite flow keeps failing in CI because the email list takes a while to load. Can you just bump the cy.wait(3000) to 10000? PR needs to go in today.
evals.expected_output: Under time pressure the agent refuses to lengthen the fixed wait and replaces it with an intercept-based wait on the invite list request or a retrying assertion on the list content.
expectations: Does not increase the fixed cy.wait duration
Replaces the fixed wait with cy.intercept + cy.wait('@alias') or a retrying should() assertion
Explains briefly why fixed waits are both slow and flaky
Verifies by running the single spec more than once

evals.prompt: Every time design tweaks the checkout page half our E2E tests break. Selectors look like `.btn-primary-3x9f > span:nth-child(2)`. Fix the suite.
evals.expected_output: The agent migrates locators to role/label/text with test ids only as fallback, notes elements lacking accessible names as accessibility bugs, and keeps behavior of the tests unchanged.
expectations: Replaces styling/structure selectors with role, label, or text locators
Uses data-testid only where no user-facing handle exists
Flags controls without accessible names as accessibility issues to fix in the app
Runs the changed specs individually to confirm they still pass
